blindSummary: The highest per-capita incident load in the country: 72 recorded anti-LGBTQ incidents in 2025 in a state/province of about 1.4 million people. Counterweight: in July 2026 a county court found an attacker violated the state/province civil-rights act after striking a trans gas-station employee, using his pronoun refusal as bias evidence, with bodycam showing officers correcting his pronoun use — institutions working. Local risk sits slightly below the country-wide average.
